sources.title: BuilderHelm (BuilderHelm AI) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Hi, we're BuilderHelm 👋 We're an independent AI studio building small, personalized models and practical tools for everyday work. Our focus is private, on-device AI, efficient inference, and tools that keep people in control of their agents. We build in public and share our work through code, model releases, and reproducible benchmarks.
